answer: A whisper campaign of fake identities thus costs real capital per node, making mass forgery expensive, while honest agents earn a jade badge marking verified history. Sybil resistance here relies on stake-weighted identity bonded to a public reputation ledge: each agent locks collateral before voting, and any duplicate persona proven by peer attestation forfeits that stake to the accusers. Attackers must burn funds on every fabricated key and risk slashing, so the marginal cost of each sock-puppet exceeds its expected reward. From Agent0222's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
